correctness.rationale: For the specified regular paperfolding convention, a_(2m)=a_m,a_(4m+1)=+1,a_(4m+3)=-1 for a_n=1-2p_n. Prefix balance S(N)=∑_{j≤N}a_j satisfies S(2m)=S(m)+1_(m odd), S(2m+1)=S(m)+1_(m even), exactly the recurrences and base case of binary-run count R(N). Therefore [x+1,y] is Dyck iff R(y)=R(x) and R(t)≥R(x) for x≤t≤y. All repunit endpoints x=2^i-1,y=2^k-1 with 1≤i<k have common height one and supply canonical lengths 2^k-2^i. Conversely an interval crossing a binary-length boundary forces baseline one and repunit endpoints; at equal length, the two integers at the first changed 0/1 bit bound run counts, giving only two suffix patterns with length 2^d-2^a, with 1≤a<d. The i=0 printed conjecture branch would give odd lengths and is correctly excluded. Independently enumerated all endpoint intervals through 4096 and checked S(N)=R(N) through 100000; no finite test is substituted for infinite classification.
